entities.name: Jayavarman VII's Buddhist Empire
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Jayavarman VII's defeat of Champa, his conversion of the state religion to Mahayana Buddhism, the construction of Angkor Thom, the Bayon, Ta Prohm, and an enormous road and hospital network.
